messages.content:
Which retailer sells the trouser with a 34 inch inseam, and what is its returns policy?

Search the catalogue as many times as needed, then call finish. Report `unknown` for anything the catalogue does not say.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search the product catalogue. Returns matching entries, or a note that none matched.

Pass a few words, such as a garment name or a retailer name.

tools.name: finish
tools.description:
Call this tool with the final answer. Its arguments are the answer itself and are validated against the required schema.
A field that accepts `unknown` takes either form, and both are answers:
  "inseam_cm": 81
  "inseam_cm": {"type": "unknown", "reason": "not listed on the page"}
Send the object, not the word. A guess presented as a fact is not an answer, and neither is the string "unknown" where the object belongs.

Unknown.description: The value the field asks for, where the agent established that it is not available. Supply `reason` saying what was looked for and what was found instead.

reason.description: What was looked for, and what was found instead.
reason.title: Reason

retailer.description: The value itself, or {"type": "unknown", "reason": "..."} where it is not available. Send the object, not the word "unknown".
retailer.title: Retailer

returns_policy.description: The value itself, or {"type": "unknown", "reason": "..."} where it is not available. Send the object, not the word "unknown".
returns_policy.title: Returns Policy
